title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเสริมสร้างการศึกษาขั้นพื้นฐาน ค.ศ. 2013

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2026/ra_12322_2026.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: All laws, orders, issuances, rules and regulations or parts thereof inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed or amended accordingly.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days following its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
